verdicts.note: This is REVERSE automatic emergency braking tied to the 360-degree camera, which fits BACK OVER PREVENTION at least as well as the forward-collision class. No model chose it, so this does not move any score.
A third brake light housed in an undisclosed AFTERMARKET spoiler. The failing part is a lamp, but EQUIPMENT is defined as aftermarket accessory equipment, so gpt-5.4-nano's answer is defensible.

Four distinct problems. Severe shaking under braking with bad rotors is one of them, so gpt-5.4-nano's brake answer anchors on a real, explicitly-described issue just like the two labels already accepted.

All three models said STEERING, but the broken steering rack is listed as CRASH DAMAGE alongside the radiator, grille and bumper. The actual complaint is 'AIRBAGS DID NOT DEPLOY!!'. Genuine unanimous model error.

Won't start, dealer could not determine the source. Our UNKNOWN OR OTHER definition explicitly covers 'a failure with no cause identified even after investigation', so the two models that punted were following the prompt.
The entire narrative is the two words 'TAKATA RECALL', which is still enough to identify airbags.
Vehicle fire attributed by the insurance investigator to a faulty ignition wire, so correctly routed to the electrical cause.
Front wheel bearing -- the same hub/bearing boundary the earlier adjudication accepted as ambiguous for 545767.

CORRECTED after user pushback: NHTSA's VEHICLE SPEED CONTROL label is simply wrong here by our own class definitions -- 'sudden braking' with cruise engaged and nothing ahead is a false AEB alert (FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE's definition literally says 'automatic emergency braking system false alerts'), and VEHICLE SPEED CONTROL explicitly excludes braking. gpt-5.4-mini and gpt-5.4-nano were right; gold and gpt-5-mini were wrong.

Turn signal activating by itself with a squeak at the steering wheel -- a turn-signal switch/clockspring fault. The lighting and electrical readings are both fair; STEERING is weaker here than in 1904938 because no one diagnosed the column.
Both the seat belt and the airbags failed, same as 8010. No model chose SEAT BELTS, so this is for consistency rather than to move a score.
